items.title: The Most Useful New AI Features and Tools to Try
items.summary: A features-and-tools week: Claude gets a browser, ChatGPT learns to move between temporary and permanent, Gemini transcription starts capturing intent instead of just words, and AI video crosses the faster-than-real-time line — all against a headlines backdrop where NVIDIA confirms its $12.9B Hugging Face buy and nearly posts a $100B quarter.

items.title: A rethink for China’s carmakers as regulators tell them to fix quality, not add features
items.summary:
Four Chinese ministries have begun a yearlong vehicle quality campaign that bars carmakers from changing technical parameters through over-the-air updates after test samples are sealed, with penalties including suspension from the product catalogue. A separate mandatory standard requires physical controls for 19 functions from July 2027. Four Chinese ministries have launched a yearlong inspection campaign […]
